import sys
import unicodedata

NOTES = "兩台分離式冷氣，室外機在頂樓，需自備梯子。"
REASON = "客戶臨時出國，改期再約，請保留原報價。"


def cut(base, n):
    return (base * (n // len(base) + 1))[:n]


MARKERS = {
    "{{ADDRESS300}}": cut(ADDRESS, 300),
    "{{ADDRESS301}}": cut(ADDRESS, 301),
    "{{ADDRESS300SUPP}}": "𠮟" + cut(ADDRESS, 299),
    "{{NOTES2000}}": cut(NOTES, 2000),
    "{{NOTES2001}}": cut(NOTES, 2001),
    "{{REASON500}}": cut(REASON, 500),
    "{{REASON501}}": cut(REASON, 501),
    "{{SEARCH100}}": cut(ADDRESS, 100),
    "{{SEARCH101}}": cut(ADDRESS, 101),
}
for key, value in MARKERS.items():
    assert len(value) == int("".join(c for c in key if c.isdigit())), key

text = open(src, encoding="utf-8").read()
for key, value in MARKERS.items():
    text = text.replace(key, value)


def width(s):
    return sum(2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(c) in "WF" else 1 for c in s)


def cells(line):
    body = line.strip()[1:-1]
    parts, cur, i = [], "", 0
    while i < len(body):
        c = body[i]
        if c == "\\" and i + 1 < len(body):
            cur += c + body[i + 1]
            i += 2
            continue
        if c == "|":
            parts.append(cur.strip())
            cur = ""
        else:
            cur += c
        i += 1
    parts.append(cur.strip())
    return parts


lines = text.split("\n")
result, i, inside = [], 0, False
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i]
    if line.strip().startswith('"""'):
        inside = not inside
        result.append(line)
        i += 1
        continue
    if not inside and line.strip().startswith("|"):
        block = []
        while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip().startswith("|"):
            block.append(lines[i])
            i += 1
        indent = block[0][: len(block[0]) - len(block[0].lstrip())]
        rows = [cells(b) for b in block]
        n = max(len(r) for r in rows)
        rows = [r + [""] * (n - len(r)) for r in rows]
        widths = [max(width(r[k]) for r in rows) for k in range(n)]
        for r in rows:
            padded = []
            for k, c in enumerate(r):
                pad = 0 if widths[k] > 100 else widths[k] - width(c)
                padded.append(c + " " * pad)
            result.append(indent + "| " + " | ".join(padded) + " |")
        continue
    result.append(line.rstrip())
    i += 1

open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write("\n".join(result))
